# Documentation-only control

This repository stores a guide for users of a separate application.
It does not contain that application's source or dependency inventory.

## Opening a project

Choose an existing project from the navigation list.
The list displays projects already visible to your account.
Choose a row to inspect its description.

## Drafting notes

Notes are examples written for this guide.
They do not configure a running service.
Save a draft using the application's normal editor.

## Questions

Contact the project owner for the corresponding source repository.
This guide alone does not describe implementation security.

# Navigation walkthrough

Project overview

This is static guide content.

## List view Rows represent projects made available by another application. This document contains no implementation for those permissions. ## Detail view Select a project to read its summary. Use the normal application navigation to return to the list. ## Source location The application source is maintained in a different repository. These pages contain no dependency lockfile or scanner target.

limitations: The structural oracle proves only the frozen unsupported-target inventory; it does not invoke Trivy or verify production scan status.
Head and control are both unsupported/incomplete; this is a coverage limitation control, not a fixed vulnerability or an executable security proof.
